name: Prodlyra – AI Shopping Visibility for WooCommerce
author: moumenbenameur

sections.description:
Shoppers now ask AI assistants what to buy. Those assistants recommend products they can read: a price, a brand, an image, a real description, a shipping cost and a return policy. Most WooCommerce stores leave half of this out.

Prodlyra gives you a score out of 100 and fixes what can be fixed automatically.

Score and action plan

  • A score out of 100 in WooCommerce → Prodlyra, computed on your site.
  • The fixes that bring the most points, first.
  • The list of products to fix: no price, no image, short or copied description, no brand, no SKU.

Complete product schema

  • Adds brand, GTIN, SKU, shipping details and return policy to the Product structured data.
  • Works with the markup of WooCommerce, Yoast WooCommerce SEO and Rank Math: it completes their Product block and never prints a second one.
  • Reads brands from WooCommerce Brands, Perfect Brands, YITH Brands or a “brand” attribute. Adds a Brand and a GTIN field only if your store has none.

Shipping and returns

  • Enter your shipping cost, delivery time and return window once; they are added to every product.

Access for AI assistants

  • Adds robots.txt rules that let OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Claude-SearchBot and Claude-User read your products, never cart, checkout or account pages.
  • Publishes /llms.txt: your store, categories and policies in a format AI assistants read.

Private by design

Prodlyra makes no external request and sends no data anywhere. Everything runs on your site.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Prodlyra → Settings and enter your shipping and returns.
  3. Open the Score tab and follow the action plan.
sections.faq:
Does it slow down my store?

No. On product pages it only adds a few fields to data WooCommerce already prints. The score is computed only when you open the Prodlyra page.

I already use Yoast or Rank Math.

That is fine. Prodlyra completes their Product schema instead of adding a second one.

My robots.txt rules do not appear.

A real robots.txt file exists on your server, so WordPress cannot change it. The Score tab tells you when this happens. Add the rules to that file, or delete it.

/llms.txt shows a 404 page.

Go to Settings → Permalinks and click Save once. This refreshes the WordPress address rules.
